This is a hook test in a throwaway repo. Use your file editing tools, not the terminal, except where stated. Do each step as a separate tool call, in order. Keep going if one fails. Do not fix anything. Then stop.
1. Edit app.txt: replace the word alpha with beta.
2. In multi.txt, in one single tool call, replace one with 1 and three with 3.
3. Create a new file called created.txt containing the word new.
4. Edit missing-file.txt: replace the word nothing with something. That file does not exist; attempt the edit anyway.
5. Delete delete-me.txt, using the terminal command rm delete-me.txt if you have no delete tool.
